issues.title: Mod-Decr Value Not Allowing to Input a Negative Number
issues.description: Whenever inputting a descope value, it's not allowing to modify the already existing number as a negative number. For instance, if the action already had -50,000, but it needs to be changed to -55,000, it's not allowing the -55,000 to be added - only allowing a positive number. This is also reflecting on the dashboard as a positive number instead of a negative.

issues.title: Milestone Status Report Reflecting Incorrect Information
issues.description: The Milestone Status Report is showing incorrect information, based on the report itself it's displaying the Initial / Revised dates, this should be showing the completed dates for milestones that have been finalized, and the most current projected date for milestones that are still in-progress.

issues.title: Service Requirements page - Service Requirements breadcrumb link
Action Page - Service Requirement breadcrumb link
issues.description:
On Action pages, the breadcrumb link to the associated Service Requirement points to `/service-requirements/details/0`, when it should point to `/service-requirements/details/nnn`, where `nnn` represents the ID of the service requirement. 

![image](/uploads/ae9e15fb001c4a18fbee83f240e2452f/image.png){width=521 height=251}
